text:
Sam: FYI launching an enterprise pilot next week with a bank — they want a 6-week POC. Need help scoping success criteria and quick model fit checks.
Emma: TL;DR: they need 32k+ context, tool calling to query internal APIs, and embeddings for semantic search + reranking on top. Budget is sensitive.
Maria: Quick checklist: 1) max context length required (how many tokens typical per convo/doc?) 2) tool call shapes (sync vs async; binary attachments?) 3) embedding index size and expected qps.
Sam: Context: customer will feed ~40–50KB docs per request after extraction (~6–8k tokens). Also want multi-doc summarization across case files (10 docs).
Emma: So 32k context seems marginal — they want rollup across many docs. We should propose a hybrid: embeddings + rerank for search + short-context generator for final answer.
Jon: From infra/deploy: if they want private VPC + HSM, that adds a week for infra provisioning. Dedicated capacity request would need a minimum commit.
Liz: Security: they asked about SOC2, KMS, and data residency (EU). We need to confirm tooling for audit logs & access controls. I'll handle questionnaire items.
Maria: Model fit notes: prefer a model variant that supports tool calling with structured JSON output and stable deterministic outputs for evaluations. Quantized 8-bit variant ok for embeddings/rerank, but generation quality matters — suggest a 2-model pattern: embed/rerank: smaller low-cost model; generator: higher-quality 32k or chunked approach.
Emma: For pricing — propose a POC package: 2 weeks free test credits + capped usage for weeks 3–6. Show cost estimates for both pure 32k-hosted vs hybrid embeddings+rerank. I'll draft numbers.
Sam: Success matrix proposal (short):
- Accuracy: pass basic evals on 100 prompt cases (>= 85% on judgement metric)
- Latency: median <500ms for search/rerank flow, median <1.5s for final generation
- Cost: token cost < $X per user-month (TBD)
- Security: SOC2 + EU-residency confirmation
Maria: Add evaluation specifics: keep an eval set of 100 labelled cases + 300 unlabeled for qualitative review. Include prompt templates and instructions so we can reproduce.
Emma: Timeline draft: Week0: infra + security signoff; Week1: data ingestion & embedding indexing; Week2: rerank + eval loop; Week3: generator integration + tool calling; Weeks4–5: iterate; Week6: handoff + QBR.
Jon: FYI autoscaling with high qps for rerank needs either Dedicated or tuned batchers in Hosted; I'll list tradeoffs.
Liz: Send me the security questionnaire PDF and the list of required compliance items — I'll review and return redlines within 48h.
Sam: Action items: Emma to share cost nos, Maria to propose model variants (names + perf tradeoffs), Jon to outline infra lead times, Liz to pick up sec questionnaire. I'll coordinate customer kickoff.
deploy-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/poc/1747264829 — please keep notes there. :white_check_mark:
Emma: Posting quick model variant suggestions in doc. Ping me if we need to carve out a short demo prompt set for legal to validate.
Maria: Also noting tool calling considerations: prefer explicit schema for tool responses. Example pattern we want:```json
{
  "action": "search",
  "query": "<string>",
  "filters": {"date_from": "YYYY-MM-DD"}
}```
Sam: Great, keep this thread as the one source of truth until kickoff. Thanks everyone.
